author: Yffe
content: Canonical spec source from which THERMITE.skill.md is generated (#7). Two deliverables: (1) formal grammar for surface syntax per design 4 (fn with mandatory req/ens/fx, loop with mandatory inv/dec, spec fn, #[slag] attr, explicit {} blocks, no significant whitespace, no macros/traits/lifetimes). (2) SpecTherm combinator registry (design 4.2/7): forall_in, forall_below, forall_from, exists_in, count_where, sorted, permutation_of, disjoint, ... each with a FROZEN SMT trigger and both a Verus definition (L3) and an executable form (L1). Registry is the single source of truth for both lowering (#4) and the skill (#7).
